title: Stop Crossing Your Arms When Turning (Part 1)
hook: Stop crossing your arms right now.

script.narration: Stop crossing your arms right now. Doing this during a tight turn cuts your control in half.
script.visual_search: driver hands crossing steering wheel dangerously

script.narration: Instead, use the push and pull method. One hand pushes up while the other pulls down. Your arms never cross over the center.
script.visual_search: correct hands on steering wheel push pull technique

script.narration: Follow so you don't miss Part 2 where we cover the exact hand placement for high speed turns!
script.visual_search: driver turning steering wheel smoothly close up

description:
Learn the correct way to handle your steering wheel during sharp turns. This simple technique improves vehicle control and safety for beginners.
